blurb: Oklahoma River Cruises operates ferry transit service along a seven-mile stretch of the Oklahoma River. Service is seasonal from April through November, Wednesday through Sunday, connecting four landings: Bricktown, Regatta Park, Stockyards, and Meridian. They offer public ferry rides, themed cruises, and private charters for various events.
